messages.subject: Installing RRO 3.2.2 on Debian Stable
parts:
This week, I installed RRO on Debian Stable, and at the moment it works fine.

First, I downloaded libjpeg8 from https://packages.debian.org/es/sid/libjpeg8 and installed it.

Finally, https://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/documents/rro/installation/#revorinst-lin

Note, previously I had R installed in my PC.
